data.text: Complex filters on large datasets can generate inefficient SQL. Always test generated queries and add database indexes on filtered columns.

data.title: Build an Advanced Event Filter
data.description: Create an EventFilterInput that filters by name (contains), date range (start and end), and location (exact match). Wire it into the GetEvents query.
steps: Define EventFilterInput with Name, StartDate, EndDate, Location
Update GetEvents to accept the filter
data.expectedOutcome: Clients can run complex filtered queries like getEvents(filter: {startDate: "2024-01-01", location: "NYC"}).
